programs.title: Batman Azteca: Choque de Imperios
programs.desc: Times of the Aztec Empire.The village leader, Toltecatzin, is murdered by the conquistadors.His son, Yohualli Coatl, flees to Tenochtitlán to warn King Moctezuma and his high priest Yoka.

programs.title: The Seed of the Sacred Fig
programs.desc: Tehran.Lawyer Iman (Missagh Zareh) is promoted to the position of investigating judge, which brings both financial benefits and a higher social status to his family, as well as a number of restrictive rules and obligations.Gradually, the man discovers the dark side of his new role - he is to approve death sentences for activists without fair trials.His nomination coincides with street protests following the death of a young woman detained by the police.The atmosphere in Iman's house becomes tense.The daughters, Rezvan (Mahsa Rostami) and Sana (Setareh Maleki), previously absorbed in school and friendships, begin to rebel more and more boldly against their father and the authority he represents and justifies.Najmeh's mother (Soheila Golestani) tries to calm the conflict.The situation becomes dramatic when Iman's service weapon disappears from his drawer... A moving story about the ethical dilemmas of ordinary people trapped in the gears of an authoritarian system.

programs.title: Tempete
programs.desc: Zoe (Carmen Kassovitz) grew up surrounded by horses in her parents' (Mélanie Laurent and Pio Marmai) racing stable.This is her place on earth.He dreams of one day becoming a jockey like his father.When a new foal is born, the girl is the first to notice its potential to become a champion.The family's life changes one tragic night, when a scared mare accidentally injures Zoe.The teenager, overcome with despair, completely breaks down.Thanks to the support of her parents and the help of the stable boy (Kacey Mottet Klein), who has an extraordinary gift for communicating with horses, Zoe decides to overcome adversity and regain what seemed lost.

programs.title: IO
programs.desc: A donkey working in a circus performs with a young artist (Sandra Drzymalska).When he regains freedom thanks to activists, his wandering begins.During his journey, he experiences joy and pain.

programs.title: Her
programs.desc: Los Angeles.Theodore makes a living by writing letters to order.He experiences a painful divorce from Catherine.His friend Amy supports him in difficult times.He spends his free time playing computer games and occasional dates.One day he buys a new operating system that can meet all user needs.She uses the software's capabilities by communicating with a virtual character with a sensual voice, Samantha.He quickly realizes that this cybernetic consciousness understands him perfectly.He has great knowledge, sense of humor and feelings.Theodore realizes that he has met the ideal woman.Attempts are made to create an unconventional relationship.

programs.title: Miami Vice
programs.desc: Police officers Sonny Crockett and Ricardo Tubbs are assigned to a dangerous mission.They are busting a gang of drug smugglers, led by a man named Montoya.The trafficker is believed to be involved in the murder of two federal agents and the family of their informant.Crockett and Tubbs infiltrate the Montoi organization.Sonny begins an affair with Isabella, who invests the proceeds of crime in legal ventures.Crockett tries to protect his lover, having no idea what the woman actually does and what her true identity is.Meanwhile, Tubbs and his girlfriend, analyst Trudy Joplin, try to understand the activities of criminals using their own methods.Ricardo does not know that he is putting his beloved in danger.Wanting to reach the gang leader, two detectives decide to transport a load of drugs to southern Florida.Gradually, the lines between the rules of the underworld and the rule of law are blurring.

programs.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programs.desc: Sarah (Margot Robbie) and David (Colin Farrell) meet at a friend's wedding.They go on an expedition during which they relive the most important moments from their past.

programs.title: A Complete Unknown
programs.desc: The year is 1961. Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan (Timothée Chalamet) from Minnesota visits his idol - folk singer Woody Guthrie (Scoot McNairy) in the hospital.The artist suffering from Huntington's disease is cared for by his friend, Pete Seeger (Edward Norton).An aspiring musician has the opportunity to present one of his songs to experienced performers.They notice his talent.Thanks to the recommendation of a scene veteran, Dylan begins performing in New York folk clubs.On his way, he meets, among others, Joan Baez (Monica Barbaro), with whom he begins cooperation and, over time, also a romance.An aura of mystery, charisma and talent lead him to the peak of popularity.The breakthrough in his career was his performance at the Newport Folk Festival in 1965.The story of the life of a music icon.The director focused on the years 1961-1965.The film received eight Oscar nominations.Actors competing for the statuette included Timothée Chalamet, Edward Norton and Monica Barbaro.

programs.title: A Working Man
programs.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.

programs.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programs.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed (Patrick Wilson) and Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) Warren face a new challenge.Mysterious forces threaten the life of their daughter, Judy.

programs.title: I.S.S
programs.desc: There are American and Russian astronauts on the International Space Station.The US team consists of Dr. Kira Foster (Ariana DeBose), who recently joined the team, officer Christian Campbell (John Gallagher Jr.) and the mission commander Gordon Barrett (Chris Messina).On a daily basis, they cooperate with the second group, which includes Weronika Vetrow (Masha Mashkova), Nikolaj Pulov (Costa Ronin) and his brother Alexei (Pilou Asbaek).Despite political and cultural differences, the astronauts get along great.There is a friendly atmosphere at the station, and Gordon and Weronika, who have started an affair, have something more in common.Everything changes when the six of them notice a terrifying phenomenon on Earth.Everyone watches with growing horror as a wave of fire spreads on the surface of the planet, where their homes and loved ones are located.This can only mean one thing - the outbreak of nuclear war.The situation escalates when Barrett learns that Russia has attacked the United States and receives an order from the US government to take control of the station.Together with Christian and Kira, they suspect that their colleagues received a similar task.Additionally, they discover that the station is currently orbiting too low.It will fall to Earth if help does not arrive within 24 hours.A fight for survival begins, and the former friends now turn on each other.

programs.title: 30 days of darkness
programs.desc: The town of Barrow, Alaska, goes dark for thirty days every year.Most residents leave their homes at this time.The safety of those who decided to stay is ensured by young sheriff Eben Olsen (Josh Hartnett).He is struggling with serious personal problems.His marriage with Stella (Melissa George) is in crisis and she wants to leave him.Soon, however, they must unite their forces and fight the vampires who attack a town cut off from the world and plunged in darkness.Hungry monsters launch a bloody hunt for people imprisoned in Barrow.Eben, Stella and a handful of survivors begin their fight for survival.They do everything to wait for the end of the polar night.Adapted from a comic book by Steve Niles and Ben Templesmith.
